correctness.rationale: The original four bang axioms yield monotonicity and fixed multiplicative idempotent images, hence exactly floor maps to endpoint-containing subunit idempotent sets. On these sets product equals minimum. Pair commutation is equivalent to absence of both exclusive fixed-point types in each common-gap; explicit generating functions give \(1/(1-4z+2z^2)\). A standalone checker enumerated 50,068 unary functions on NM chains of orders 2–6 and all floor pairs for idempotent chains of orders 2–9, confirming the analytic proof on those finite ranges. The sharp \(n=6\) NM counterexample is explicit.

value.rationale: Multiple linear-logic exponentials invite the structural question of whether sequential application is order-independent or remains a lawful exponential. A complete fixed-point criterion answers this for all finite Girard chains and yields exact ordered-pair counts and a sharp minimal noncommutation example on the natural nilpotent-minimum series. The result is a nontrivial classification and motivated boundary, not arbitrary isolated data.
